description: This file defines interfaces and types related to listing and managing node, storage, CSI, resource claims, device classes, and workload states within the Kubernetes scheduler framework.

classes.name: NodeInfoLister
classes.description: Interface for listing and retrieving NodeInfo objects based on node name and affinity.

classes.name: StorageInfoLister
classes.description: Interface for handling storage-related operations, specifically PVC usage.

classes.name: SharedLister
classes.description: Groups scheduler-specific listers for nodes and storage.

classes.name: CSINodeLister
classes.description: Interface for listing and getting CSINode objects.

classes.name: ResourceSliceLister
classes.description: Interface for obtaining ResourceSlice objects, with device taint rules consideration.

classes.name: DeviceClassLister
classes.description: Interface for listing and getting DeviceClass objects.

classes.name: ResourceClaimTracker
classes.description: Interface for tracking ResourceClaims and their state during scheduling and binding.

classes.name: DeviceClassResolver
classes.description: Resolves device class names from extended resource names.

classes.name: SharedDRAManager
classes.description: Manages DRA objects and their in-memory modifications, mainly for simulation or API interaction.

classes.name: CSIManager
classes.description: Manages CSINode objects and their in-memory state.

classes.name: WorkloadManager
classes.description: Provides runtime workload information, including pod group states.

classes.name: PodGroupState
classes.description: Interface to view and modify the state of a pod group, including pods in various scheduling states.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Returns a list of NodeInfo objects.

methods.name: HavePodsWithAffinityList
methods.description: Returns NodeInfos with pods that have affinity terms.

methods.name: HavePodsWithRequiredAntiAffinityList
methods.description: Returns NodeInfos with pods that have required anti-affinity terms.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves NodeInfo for a specific node name.

methods.name: IsPVCUsedByPods
methods.description: Checks if a PVC is used by scheduled pods.

methods.name: NodeInfos
methods.description: Returns NodeInfoLister.

methods.name: StorageInfos
methods.description: Returns StorageInfoLister.

methods.name: ListWithDeviceTaintRules
methods.description: Lists ResourceSlices with device taint rules applied if feature enabled.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Returns list of DeviceClass objects.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Returns a DeviceClass for a given className.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Lists ResourceClaims.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Gets a specific ResourceClaim by namespace and name.

methods.name: ListAllAllocatedDevices
methods.description: Lists all allocated devices from ResourceClaims.

methods.name: GatherAllocatedState
methods.description: Gathers info about allocated devices.

methods.name: SignalClaimPendingAllocation
methods.description: Signals a claim will be allocated in the API.

methods.name: ClaimHasPendingAllocation
methods.description: Checks if a claim has a pending allocation.

methods.name: RemoveClaimPendingAllocation
methods.description: Removes pending allocation for a claim.

methods.name: AssumeClaimAfterAPICall
methods.description: Marks a claim as assumed after API modification.

methods.name: AssumedClaimRestore
methods.description: Restores a claim's state if API modification failed.

methods.name: GetDeviceClass
methods.description: Resolves device class from resource name.

methods.name: ResourceClaims
methods.description: Returns ResourceClaimTracker.

methods.name: ResourceSlices
methods.description: Returns ResourceSliceLister.

methods.name: DeviceClasses
methods.description: Returns DeviceClassLister.

methods.name: DeviceClassResolver
methods.description: Returns DeviceClassResolver.

methods.name: ResourceClaims
methods.description: Returns ResourceClaimTracker.

methods.name: ResourceSlices
methods.description: Returns ResourceSliceLister.

methods.name: DeviceClasses
methods.description: Returns DeviceClassLister.

methods.name: DeviceClassResolver
methods.description: Returns DeviceClassResolver.

methods.name: CSINodes
methods.description: Returns CSINodeLister.

methods.name: PodGroupState
methods.description: Provides state management for pod groups, including pods in various scheduling states.
